posts.title: FlintFix 1.7: every version, one installer
items: FlintFix in-game features now work on 15 Minecraft versions: 1.20.1 through 1.21.11, plus the new 26.1, 26.2 and 26.3.
One setup file installs everything. No Java download or mod build on first launch, because the mod comes ready inside the installer.
The installer asks if you want a desktop shortcut and starts FlintFix when it finishes.
The launcher icon, loading screen and default profile pictures now use the real Minecraft flint.
Automatic updates: new versions download in the background and install with one click.
Official FlintFix Discord bot with /download, /status, /versions and /report.
The launcher is smaller, faster to start and better protected.

posts.title: FlintFix 1.0 is here
items: A new animated loading screen when the launcher opens.
Fabric is now the default loader, and works on every Minecraft version. FlintFix's in-game features run on 1.21.1; other versions launch with Fabric and Fabric API only.
One accent color across the whole launcher, smoother page changes and cleaner menus.
In-game menus and HUD polished and checked for glitches.
Forge and NeoForge are marked as coming soon.

posts.title: Servers, skins and waypoints
items: Servers tab: save favorite servers, see who's online, and join in one click.
Skins tab: a 3D preview, a skin library, and one-click skin changes.
Waypoints in game: save places, see them in the world and on the compass.
Server profiles: FlintFix switches to your chosen module profile when you join a server.
Performance mode installs Sodium, Lithium and other speed-up mods in one click.
The launcher now tells you when a new FlintFix version is out.

posts.title: Ten new modules
items: Potion effects, speed meter and compass bar HUD widgets.
Custom block outline and crosshair.
Low fire, shield and totem, damage numbers, no weather, motion blur and team glow.

posts.title: Resource packs and a cinematic sky
items: Browse and preview resource packs in the new Packs tab.
Show Hand holds your item, with a new Inspect animation.
A more cinematic Custom Sky and a redesigned HUD.
